noah: Quick ask for runtime 100-query mini-probe for launch copy. Need smoke + one quantized trial. Deliverables in ~48h?

ivy: can do. please specify exact artifacts and the runner we should use.

noah: minimal bundle: (1) per-request CSV: req_id, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_tag; (2) aggregates: p50/p90/p99 + avg tokens; (3) warm vs cold heatmap PNG; (4) runner_cmd.txt (redact keys) + seed link; (5) one quantized trace if available. Gate: <1% errors and note any fallback.

carla: add: include mean batch size observed and cache hit percent. If quantized p99 > baseline by >15% mark as "do not use in headline". Seed: https://redwood.co/samples/launch-proof-100.csv. Baseline tag: rw-large-v1:2026-03-10. Quant tag: rw-large-v1-q4_0. Runner example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY' -d '{"model":"rw-large-v1:2026-03-10","input_file":"launch-proof-100.csv","max_tokens":200}'

noah: tagging runtimebot for slot and ETA @runtimebot

runtimebot: job created id=jb_3543_mkt. Est 1.8h on staging-gpu-1. q4 kernels present; will record any fallback events.

runtimebot: job jb_3543_mkt finished (1h52m). Artifacts saved: /artifacts/jb_3543_mkt/ (latency.csv, aggregates.csv, heatmap.png, runner_cmd_redacted.txt, README.txt). Metrics: mean_batch=3.5, cache_rate=10%. Quantized p99 = +14% vs baseline. No request failures.
